beer.beer_description:
Strap in and blast off. Our Galactic Monkey NEIPA returns with a fresh cosmic upgrade—loaded with wet Galaxy hops for an out-of-this-world burst of flavour.
This hazy IPA pours thick and glowing, launching waves of passionfruit, peach, and citrus straight from the stratosphere. The addition of freshly harvested wet Galaxy hops amplifies the aroma—bringing a brighter, greener intensity and a lush, juicy edge that only comes once a year.
Soft on the palate with a pillowy mouthfeel and low bitterness, it’s a smooth ride through a nebula of tropical haze.
Wrapped in our galactic monkey decal, this brew captures the spirit of interstellar mischief—where our pickled primate drifts through space, chasing the freshest hops in the universe.
Limited release. Fresh hop season. Zero gravity required.
